intro.text: Brightness Tanalan, highlady of Rathalas in southern Alethkar.

items.text: When Gavilar's forces attacked Rathalas, Dalinar fatally wounded her husband, Brightlord Tanalan, in a duel. Following him to a hidden room, Dalinar found her draped over her dying husband with their young son, who tried to wield his father's Shardblade. Dalinar took the Blade but spared her and the boy, despite orders to kill the child. What became of her afterwards is unknown.
